messages:
maya: Heads up — seeing a spike of 504s for hosted inference in eu-west-1 starting ~09:12 UTC. ~3.2k 5xx over 10m, p95 latency jumped from 2.4s -> 8.9s. Gateway returning 504s across multiple customers. tagging oncall (jordan) and eng-runtime.
metrics-bot: alert: hosted-inference.eu-west-1.gateway.5xx_rate = 18% (09:14 UTC). grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hosted-inference/eu-west-1?panel=5

samantha: support: several customers reported client-side timeouts and 504s. Example payload from AcmeCorp: their SDK shows repeated retries then 504s. Repro curl attached below.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-rtl-2","input":"test","max_tokens":1024}' \
  --max-time 30
```

ashok: Quick triage: we rolled a proxy config change (sticky-session / connection-pool) at 09:05 as part of proxy-tweak v2. I see spike in connection resets from gateway -> inference-backend pods starting 09:10. Upstream worker queue length jumped.
deploy-bot: canary: proxy-tweak v2 rolled to 20% @09:05, promoted to 80% @09:09. Rollback available via canary pipeline.

ryan: Stand down suggestion: rollback proxy-tweak to v1 in eu-west-1 and monitor. If rollback reduces 504s, we can attribute it to the change. Jordan, can you take the rollback?
jordan: Oncall here — initiating rollback now. Running: 
```
kubectl -n gateway rollout undo deployment/gateway-proxy --to-revision=110 --context=eu-west-1
```
Estimated time ~2-5m. Will watch metrics.

elena: Support will send interim status to affected customers and open SLO impact tickets. I'll coordinate the outreach and capture exact customer lists.
metrics-bot: post-rollback metrics: 504 rate decreased from 18% -> 6% within 5m of rollback (09:22 UTC). p95 latency trending down.

maya: Mitigations applied: 1) rolled back proxy-tweak v2, 2) temporarily increased circuit-breaker threshold to avoid immediate cascade for long-poll/streaming requests, 3) enabled fallback routing to model-v1-fallback for heavy requests.

ashok: Initial root-cause hypothesis: proxy-tweak v2's aggressive connection pooling + keepalives caused upstream worker threads to saturate when many concurrent streaming requests arrived, leading to connection resets and 504s. Need to validate with debug logs and heap metrics.

ryan: Agreed. Action items from triage: revert published change (stop auto-promo), add canary failure threshold (fail promotion if 5xx_rate > 2% during canary), add e2e streaming concurrency tests, and add worker-queue alerts.
jordan: Rollback completed @09:27 UTC. Observed 504s return to baseline <1% by 09:33. I'll keep a 30m watch window.

samantha: Customer impact summary: 4 enterprise customers reported intermittent 504s between ~09:12-09:30 UTC. Support will open SLO impact tickets and prepare credits if needed; scheduling 1:1 calls for top two.
elena: Outreach plan: status email to all affected within 60m; call with top 2 customers scheduled for tomorrow 11:00 UTC.

maya: Post-incident action items (short):
- [A1] Block auto-promotion of proxy-tweak v2 until tests added (owner: ashok, due: 2026-03-18)
- [A2] Implement canary fail threshold for gateway config (owner: ryan, due: 2026-03-22)
- [A3] Add streaming concurrency e2e + load test to CI (owner: eng-ml, assignee: samantha/ashok, due: 2026-03-25)
- [A4] Add alert for gateway upstream worker queue length & connection resets (owner: maya, due: 2026-03-20)
- [A5] Run retro with DEV/QA on canary criteria and update runbook (owner: elena, due: 2026-03-21)

ryan: Adding A2/A3 to our sprint board. I'll own follow-up for canary changes. :thumbsup:
jordan: Will attach rollback logs and kube events to the incident ticket.

metrics-bot: summary: elevated 504s lasted ~40m (09:12-09:52), root cause correlated with proxy-tweak v2 promotion. Postmortem scheduled Mon 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC (calendar invite to follow).

maya: Final notes: preserve debug logs from gateway pods (don't rotate) for further analysis, include thread dump around 09:15 if available, and capture upstream app metrics. I'll start the incident PR and assign action items.

ryan: Thanks all — good coordination. We'll follow up in postmortem with concrete remediation and verification steps.
